executiveSummary: Apple has launched its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, with a starting price of $1,999. The new iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max also feature improved cameras, faster processors, and new color options. Meanwhile, AI and machine learning continue to shape the tech industry, with OpenAI solving a Millennium Prize problem and Suno releasing its first AI music model.

takeaways.title: Foldable iPhones and pricing
takeaways.description: Apple's first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, starts at $1,999, while the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max start at $1,199 and $1,299, respectively. This marks a significant increase in pricing, with many expecting this to be the new norm for premium smartphones.

takeaways.title: AI and machine learning advancements
takeaways.description: OpenAI has solved one of mathematics' legendary Millennium Prize problems, while Suno has released its first AI music model, trained with support from the record industry. These advancements demonstrate the continued growth and innovation in AI and machine learning.

worthWatching: The iPhone Duo's foldable design and improved cameras will likely shape the future of smartphones.
engineeringPerspective: The use of nano-textured cover layers in the iPhone Duo's folding screen could lead to improved durability and reduced wear and tear.
